title: uk stocks recover bond rally lifts risk sentiment 2026 09 03
text:
Sept 3 (Reuters) - Britain's main stock indexes recovered on Thursday as a rally in global bonds ahead ​of a U.S. jobs report lifted risk sentiment, while ‌firmer commodity prices provided additional support.
The blue-chip FTSE 100 index (.FTSE)
, opens new tab
 closed 0.7% higher at 10,831.52 points, and the midcap FTSE 250 (.FTMC)
, opens new tab
 also gained ​0.7%, rebounding from a near one-month low.
